subject: SOC2 tooling: vendor scorecard + demo sprint plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC2 tooling: vendor scorecard + demo sprint plan

All,

We need to finalize which SOC2 automation provider we pilot for the next 60 days as part of the audit readiness program for Northstar Health. Based on the shortlist (Vanta, Drata) I propose a short, structured "demo sprint" to evaluate: implementation velocity, evidence collection model, TB retention, SSO and SCIM integration complexity, and overall TCO.

Plan (high level):
- 1-week setup with each vendor (parallel) for a basic controls surface and SSO/SCIM connection
- 1-week handoff + walk-through + evidence generation tests
- Score using a standardized vendor scorecard (attached) across product, security controls, operations, and cost buckets

Immediate asks:
1) Procurement: scope of licensing pricing we need to collect for TCO (seat vs org-based, evidence ingestor cost, retention tiers).
2) Legal: minimum SOW terms we need for proof-of-concept pilots (I attached a minimal SOW template to speed negotiation).
3) Ops: stakeholder list for technical kickoff (who can attend setup calls).

Attachments: soc2-vendor-scorecard-template.xlsx, demo-sprint-outline.pdf, sow-minimum-terms.docx

Timelines: want vendor confirmations and available demo slots by EOD Monday 11/29 so we can run the sprint week of 12/6. If you have objections, flag now.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nsh-health.com
Date: 2026-11-27T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 tooling: vendor scorecard + demo sprint plan

+1 on the sprint approach. A few procurement/legal specifics to collect from vendors before we start the pilot: 
- Full pricing matrix (monthly/annual) with any onboarding fees and overage / per-evidence charges
- Clarify support SLAs during pilot (response time for setup blockers)
- Any data residency / processing agreements and SOC2 audit reports (if available)
- Cancellation terms for pilots and auto-renew clauses

I've attached a short vendor questionnaire (one-pager) and the SOW minimums. Please use the scorecard to capture TCO estimates (we'll normalize to 12-month run rate).

Procurement lead: I'll coordinate with Northstar procurement (cc'd). Legal (Mina) — can you confirm whether the SOW template covers a pilot or we need an addendum?

Karthik
Director, Product GTM

---Attachment: vendor-questions-onepager.pdf---

From: Sara Patel <sara@vanta.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 tooling: vendor scorecard + demo sprint plan

Hi Jasmine / team,

Thanks for the outline — Vanta can run the proposed sprint. Proposed availability: setup week 12/6 and walk-throughs 12/13. For the pilot we typically provide:
- Project manager + onboarding engineer
- Sandbox connection instructions for SSO/SCIM and doc ingestion
- A temporary POC license covering up to 2 org admins and 500 evidence checks

I attached a short demo checklist and a draft POC order form. We can sign a one-page MSA addendum if that helps speed procurement.

Questions for you:
1) Who will own the SCIM connection on your side?
2) Any special encryption/KMS requirements?
3) Are you planning to ingest evidence via API or Google Drive connectors for the sprint?

Attachments: vanta-demo-checklist.pdf, vanta-poc-orderform.pdf

Best,
Sara Patel
Enterprise Partnerships, Vanta

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 tooling: vendor scorecard + demo sprint plan

Thanks — this looks good. A few operational notes before we lock in: 
- I'll be the SCIM/IdP owner for the sprint and can block 90m on 12/6 for setup.
- Markus will lead evidence-injection tests (we'll use a mix of Drive connectors + API mocks).
- Mina: if legal signs off on the one-page MSA addendum, procurement can approve a POC order up to $12k without exec review. If it's more, we need a finance exception.

Next steps: Jasmine to confirm slots with Drata + Vanta (ask for 45m setup + 60m handoff) and Karthik to push vendor questionnaire and price matrix. I'll populate the scorecard after each sprint day and share a combined TCO view.

Lauren
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
